title: Part One: The Dream as Taught

Figures: compare, time

The taught chain sourced to CEE Standards 13/15, C3, Mankiw, Texas TEKS, personal-finance mandates, AP US History, USCIS civics test, Schoolhouse Rock; belief polls 2025-26; told-vs-record preview. Figures: flow, stats, compare

Presidents of both parties quoted with dates (Clinton, Bush, Obama, Trump, Harris); real estate boards, builders, Fannie Mae, lenders (Ameriquest); the 1995-2007 homeownership push as a money trail, FCIC vs Wallison; where it worked; labelled interpretation; the book's central question and plan.
